_comment: Occasions during the construction of docs/WHERE_IT_STOPS.md on which an adversarial pass removed a claim the author wanted to make. Recorded as DATA so the number in the document is emitted rather than typed, and so a reader can check the instances rather than the count.

occasions.claim_wanted: that the program's adversarial passes are 'independent'
occasions.why: borrows exactly the credential fixed point 2 spends a paragraph removing: same operator, same model family, no human in the loop but the author

occasions.claim_wanted: that a result is attacked 'before it may be banked'
occasions.why: the gate exits zero on a flag -- it surfaces, it does not block; the phrasing implied a lock that does not exist

occasions.claim_wanted: 'No count in this document was typed by hand'
occasions.why: falsified inside its own paragraph -- spelled-out numerals and hyphenated ratios walked past a guard that checked bare integers only

occasions.claim_wanted: 'All trace to sessions the author ran himself'
occasions.why: the register proves ABSENCE OF A LOGGED TRANSMISSION and never records modality; the attribution is the author's testimony and is now labelled as such
